description: Published tracks of MGS Audio (music, ambiences, sound effects) with composer, album, moods, keywords, duration and page url. Metadata only: no audio file. "A battle theme" → genre: "Combat", type: "music"; "a forest ambience" → type: "ambience", genre: "Forest"; "something for a dungeon" → keyword: "dungeon".

genre.description: Theme(s), comma-separated, case-insensitive: Combat, Forest, Dungeon, Taverns and Inns, Magic, Weather… (audio_taxonomy lists them).

mood.description: Musical style(s), comma-separated: Orchestral, Celtic, Folk, Medieval, Metal…

q.description: Text search in title, description, keywords.

type.description: Audio type(s), comma-separated: music, ambience, sfx…

name: search_tracks
title: Search the music catalogue
